verified: Live, Aug 2026, against the OpenAI board. __reactFiber$ confirmed on #_systemfield_name.

match.notes: Job links are always UUIDv4, which makes URL detection unambiguous. Embedded via <div id=ashby_embed> + embed.js or an iframe at jobs.ashbyhq.com/<org>/embed.

apply_url.note: /<org>/<job-uuid> is the posting; /<org>/<job-uuid>/application is the form.

upload_first_why: Ashby parses the uploaded resume and asynchronously overwrites name/email/phone/location/links. Upload the resume field first, let the parse settle, then write your values over the top.

wait_parse.why: Poll until the parse has written into #_systemfield_name, then settle before overwriting.
wait_parse.on_timeout: continue - the fields step overwrites everything that matters anyway

fields.note: input#_systemfield_resume[required] inside div.ashby-application-form-input-file-dropzone. The dropzone is cosmetic; the input is real, so no synthetic drag events.
input.ashby-application-form-input-autocomplete[role=combobox][aria-haspopup=listbox]. MUST resolve to a suggestion - a raw value set leaves the location unresolved and the form rejects it.

field_notes: Phone, LinkedIn, GitHub and everything else are per-org custom fields with per-job UUID ids - there are no stable selectors for them. They come out of question_map discovery, matched by label text.

question_map.how: Every question, system or custom, is wrapped in div.ashby-application-form-field-entry[data-field-path=<uuid>]. That wrapper is the stable hook; ids and names are per-job UUIDs. Discover, then map each label through answer_rules.

question_map.yesno_note: Yes/No renders as a <button>Yes</button>/<button>No</button> pair backed by a hidden input[type=checkbox][name=<field-uuid>]. CLICK THE BUTTON. Poking the checkbox sets the DOM and leaves React's state unchanged.
typical: Where are you currently located? (autocomplete, must resolve to a suggestion)
When can you start a new role?
Are you authorized to work in the country where the job is located? (Yes/No buttons)
Will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship? (Yes/No buttons)
Can you work from our <city> office N days per week? (Yes/No buttons)
Certification that nothing was withheld (labeled checkbox)

verify.how: plan() builds a single JS readback over every field it filled and compares against step.expect.
verify.fail_closed: Any MISSING, empty required field, unresolved location, or NO_OPTION -> human_queue.

submit.gate: db.claim(uid) must return before this click - it re-checks the tier-1 gate, auto_submit and the per-company caps. Irreversible.

captcha.where: recaptcha.net/recaptcha/api2/anchor with a g-recaptcha-response textarea; fires at submit

blockers.iframe: Only on the embed variant - navigate to jobs.ashbyhq.com/<org>/<uuid>/application directly instead.

do_not_touch.why: The top-of-form 'autocomplete your application' uploader. It kicks off a second, more aggressive async prefill that overwrites fields after you have filled them. The real resume field (#_systemfield_resume) already covers the requirement.
The hidden checkbox behind a Yes/No button pair. Click the button instead. (A standalone labeled acknowledgement checkbox is a different control and is fine to set.)
Captcha token field. Writing to it is a bypass attempt.
